subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server session wedges indefinitely after a 429 rate-limit burst — terminal-idle watchdog still gated by `activeAppServerTurnRequests > 0` (regression/incomplete fix of #82681)

question: Should this issue close from current-main source proof, or stay open until live 429 verification on a release containing PR 102160?
rationale: The merged PR and latest maintainer comment both say the failure mode should be structurally retired but still pending live report verification; source inspection also shows the literal request gate remains intentionally present.

options.title: Wait for live release proof
options.body: Keep this open until a released build containing PR 102160 is exercised against the reported 429 shared-client wedge or an equivalent live trace shows the issue is gone.

options.body: Close now if maintainers decide the source, tests, and Codex protocol proof are sufficient without live 429 confirmation.
